/dev-maestro-enhanced   DiabetesCompass — Payload CMS Configuration

CONTEXT
We're cloning the Wine Country Corner Payload structure for a new site called 
DiabetesCompass at diabetescompass.com / cms.diabetescompass.com. The site is 
already registered in Payload. We need to:

1. Configure the existing Site record
2. Strip the WCC-specific directory collections we won't use
3. Add a new Specialists collection for our medical specialist directory
4. Update Categories and Tags taxonomies for the diabetes editorial pillars

Use the database prefix wc_ as already configured.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PART 1 — SITE RECORD
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Update the existing DiabetesCompass site record with:

- name: "DiabetesCompass"
- slug: "diabetescompass"
- domain: "diabetescompass.com"
- tagline: "Find your direction."
- description: "Educational content for navigating life with diabetes. 
  Calm, research-backed orientation for the newly diagnosed, the misdiagnosed, 
  and the people caring for them."
- logo: upload from /public/brand/horizontal/horizontal-master-with-tagline.svg
- favicon: upload from /public/favicon.svg
- newsletter integration:
  - listmonk_list_id: (get from existing env config)
  - mautic_segment_id: (get from existing env config)
- theme_color: "#0F4C5C"
- background_color: "#F4EDE0"

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PART 2 — STRIP WCC-SPECIFIC COLLECTIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

For the DiabetesCompass site (filter by site = diabetescompass), DO NOT delete 
the collections themselves (other sites use them). Just ensure no records 
exist for this site in:

- Wineries
- Wines
- Restaurants
- PlacesToStay

The Events collection should be KEPT and repurposed — diabetes conferences, 
support group meetings, fundraisers, awareness days. No data migration needed; 
we'll populate fresh.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PART 3 — NEW COLLECTION: Specialists
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Create a new Payload collection called "Specialists" with this schema. Model 
it on the existing Wineries collection structure (same pattern: featured 
tiers, region filtering, claim-able listings).

Collection slug: specialists
Admin group: "Directory"

FIELDS:

Identity:
- name (text, required) — "Dr. Sarah Chen, MD" or "Diabetes Care Center of Phoenix"
- slug (text, required, unique per site) — auto-generate from name
- type (select, required) — options: "endocrinologist", "cdces", 
  "diabetes-clinic", "primary-care-with-diabetes-focus", "pediatric-endocrinologist"
- credentials (text) — "MD, FACE" or "RN, CDCES" — display after name
- npi (text) — National Provider Identifier (10 digits, used for verification 
  and dedup against NPI Registry)

Practice info:
- practiceName (text) — for individual specialists with a practice affiliation
- bio (richText) — longer description, optional
- yearsInPractice (number)
- specialties (array of select) — multi-select from: 
  ["type-1-diabetes", "type-2-diabetes", "lada", "mody", "type-3c", 
   "gestational", "pediatric", "geriatric", "insulin-pump-management", 
   "cgm-management", "diabetic-neuropathy", "diabetic-retinopathy", 
   "diabetic-kidney-disease", "weight-management-glp1"]
- languagesSpoken (array of text) — simple text array
- acceptingNewPatients (boolean, default: true)
- telehealthAvailable (boolean, default: false)

Location:
- address1 (text)
- address2 (text)
- city (text, required)
- state (text, required, 2-char code)
- zipCode (text, required)
- latitude (number)
- longitude (number)
- region (relationship → Regions collection, multi-select) — for filtering
- phone (text)
- fax (text)
- websiteUrl (text)
- bookingUrl (text) — direct link to scheduling if available

Insurance:
- insuranceAccepted (array of text) — list of accepted plans/networks

Photos:
- photo (upload, single image) — headshot for individuals, building for 
  practices
- photoGallery (upload, multiple) — optional additional photos

Listing tier (mirrors WCC's wineries pattern):
- featured (boolean, default: false)
- featuredTier (select) — options: "flagship", "featured", "standard"
- featuredOrder (number) — for sort order within tier
- claimedByOwner (boolean, default: false) — true once a specialist verifies 
  and claims their listing
- verifiedDate (date) — when verified against NPI Registry / state board

Editorial:
- editorialNote (richText) — DiabetesCompass editorial team notes about why 
  this specialist is recommended (only visible on flagship/featured listings)
- patientReviewSummary (richText) — anonymized summary of patient feedback 
  (manual editorial, not user-submitted reviews)

System:
- site (relationship → Sites, required)
- status (select, required) — "draft", "published", "archived"
- createdAt (auto)
- updatedAt (auto)
- publishedAt (date)
- dataSource (select) — "npi-registry", "manual-entry", "claimed", "imported"

ACCESS CONTROL:
- Read: public for status=published
- Create/Update/Delete: admin and editor roles only
- "Claim listing" workflow: separate logic in Phase 2

INDEXES:
- (site, status, featured, featuredTier, featuredOrder) for directory listing 
  queries
- (site, slug) unique
- (state, city) for location-based queries
- (npi) unique sparse for dedup

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PART 4 — REGIONS COLLECTION (extend existing)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The existing Regions collection from WCC was wine-region-specific (Napa, 
Sonoma, etc.). For DiabetesCompass, add region records for:

- "Major Metro" tier (top 50 US metros by population): Phoenix, Denver, 
  Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, etc. — full list to be populated later from 
  Census Bureau MSA data
- "State" tier: all 50 states
- "Region" tier: Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, Southwest, West

A specialist can be tagged to multiple regions (their metro + their state + 
their broader region). Hierarchy is informational only — not strict.

For now, just create the 50 state records. Metro records can be added as 
specialist data is imported.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PART 5 — CATEGORIES (Articles taxonomy)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

For the DiabetesCompass site, create these top-level Categories matching 
our five-pillar editorial structure:

1. slug: "newly-diagnosed"
   title: "Newly Diagnosed Navigation"
   description: "Calm orientation for the first 90 days after a diabetes 
   or prediabetes diagnosis."

2. slug: "misdiagnosed"
   title: "The Misdiagnosed"
   description: "Editorial coverage of LADA, MODY, type 3c, and the 
   diabetes types that don't fit the standard binary."

3. slug: "caregiving"
   title: "Caregiving"
   description: "Practical guidance for families managing a loved one's 
   diabetes alongside aging, dementia, or complex care."

4. slug: "daily-life"
   title: "Daily Life"
   description: "The logistics, the situations, the questions nobody 
   warned you about."

5. slug: "tools-and-tech"
   title: "Tools & Tech"
   description: "CGMs, pumps, GLP-1s, apps — decoded for the patient and 
   caregiver, not the prescriber."

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6)**_

The unique constraint exists. However, `ON CONFLICT (site_id, slug)` needs a `UNIQUE CONSTRAINT` or unique index — a `UNIQUE INDEX` works too in PostgreSQL, but the `ON CONFLICT` clause must reference the index's columns. The categories seed from `seed-citad-categories-tags.ts` uses the same pattern and already works in production, so we're good.

## What was built

### New files

**`src/collections/Specialists.ts`** — Full Specialists collection with all requested fields: identity (name, slug, type, credentials, NPI), practice info (bio as richText, specialties as hasMany select, languages, accepting/telehealth booleans), location group, regions relationship (hasMany), insurance array, photos (primary + gallery array), listing tier (featured/featuredTier/featuredOrder mirrored from Wineries), editorial fields, and system fields. Per-site slug uniqueness via the existing `ensureUniqueSlugForSite` hook pattern.

**`src/collections/Regions.ts`** — New Regions collection (name, slug, tier select state/metro/region, stateCode, description) with per-site slug uniqueness. Scoped to site like all other directory collections.

**`src/migrations/20260506_add_diabetescompass_collections.ts`** — Full migration covering: 5 new enum types, `regions` table, `specialists` table, all child tables (`specialists_specialties`, `specialists_languages_spoken`, `specialists_insurance_accepted`, `specialists_photo_gallery`, `specialists_rels`), new columns on `sites` (tagline, description, logo_id, favicon_id, theme_color, background_color, listmonk_list_id, mautic_segment_id) and `authors` (role, email), all FK constraints, and all required indexes including the sparse unique NPI index.

**`scripts/seed-diabetescompass.ts`** — Complete seed script. Run with:
```bash
npx tsx scripts/seed-diabetescompass.ts
```

### Deployment sequence

```bash
# 1. Deploy the updated image (migration runs on startup)

npx tsx scripts/seed-diabetescompass.ts
```

### After seed: manual steps

The seed script will remind you, but these four things require the Payload admin UI:
1. Upload `logo` from `/public/brand/horizontal/horizontal-master-with-tagline.svg`
2. Upload `favicon` from `/public/favicon.svg`
3. Set `listmonk_list_id` from your env config
4. Set `mautic_segment_id` from your env config
5. Upload author avatars once HeyGen renders are ready

---

### API endpoints (post-deployment)

```
GET /api/specialists?where[site.slug][equals]=diabetescompass
GET /api/articles?where[site.slug][equals]=diabetescompass
GET /api/categories?where[site.slug][equals]=diabetescompass
GET /api/tags?where[site.slug][equals]=diabetescompass
GET /api/regions?where[site.slug][equals]=diabetescompass
GET /api/authors?where[site.slug][equals]=diabetescompass
```

---

### One clarification on `wc_` prefix

The database does **not** use a `wc_` prefix — Payload names tables directly from the collection slug (e.g. `specialists`, `regions`, `categories`). That prefix appears only in historical conversation artifacts. The existing site and all collections use unprefixed table names, so no adjustment was needed there.

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TAG="${1:-latest}"
STACK_FILE="docker-stack-payload.yml"

source "./scripts/lib/env-guardrails.sh"

IMAGE="$(current_image_from_stack "${STACK_FILE}")"
[[ -n "${IMAGE}" ]] || fail "Could not resolve image from ${STACK_FILE}"

echo "Pushing image ${IMAGE}:${TAG}"
docker push "${IMAGE}:${TAG}"

if [[ "${TAG}" != "latest" ]]; then
  echo "Tagging ${IMAGE}:${TAG} as ${IMAGE}:latest"
  docker tag "${IMAGE}:${TAG}" "${IMAGE}:latest"
  docker push "${IMAGE}:latest"
fi

echo "Push complete for ${IMAGE}:${TAG}"
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

FORCE=""
SKIP_BUILD=0
SKIP_MIGRATIONS=0
TAG="latest"

for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --force)
      FORCE="--force"
      ;;
    --skip-build)
      SKIP_BUILD=1
      ;;
    --skip-migrations)
      SKIP_MIGRATIONS=1
      ;;
    --tag=*)
      TAG="${arg#--tag=}"
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown argument: $arg" &gt;&amp;2
      echo "Usage: ./scripts/deploy.sh [--force] [--skip-build] [--skip-migrations] [--tag=&lt;tag&gt;]" &gt;&amp;2
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

./scripts/preflight.sh "${FORCE}"
source "./scripts/lib/env-guardrails.sh"

load_env_file
require_stack_envs "docker-stack-postgres.yml"
require_stack_envs "docker-stack-payload.yml"

require_env "POSTGRES_PASSWORD"
require_env "PAYLOAD_SECRET"
require_env "INTERNAL_LINKER_API_KEY"
require_local_database "DATABASE_URI"

ensure_swarm_secret "postgres_password" "${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
ensure_swarm_secret "payload_secret" "${PAYLOAD_SECRET}"
ensure_swarm_secret "internal_linker_api_key" "${INTERNAL_LINKER_API_KEY}"

if [[ "${SKIP_BUILD}" -eq 0 ]]; then
  ./scripts/build.sh "${TAG}"
  ./scripts/push.sh "${TAG}"
fi

if [[ "${SKIP_MIGRATIONS}" -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "Running one-off Payload migrations before service rollout"
  pnpm payload migrate
else
  warn "Skipping migrations by request (--skip-migrations)"
fi

echo "Deploying stack payload-postgres"
docker stack deploy -c "docker-stack-postgres.yml" "payload-postgres"

echo "Deploying stack payload-swarm"
./scripts/stack-deploy-payload.sh

SERVICE_NAME="$(python3 - &lt;&lt;'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open(".xenco/meta.json", "r", encoding="utf-8"))
print(d["deploy"]["swarm_service"])
PY
)"

echo "Verifying critical runtime env vars on ${SERVICE_NAME}"
ENV_LINES="$(docker service inspect "${SERVICE_NAME}" --format '{{range .Spec.TaskTemplate.ContainerSpec.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}')"

for key in DATABASE_URI PAYLOAD_SECRET INTERNAL_LINKER_API_KEY; do
  value="$(printf "%s\n" "${ENV_LINES}" | awk -F= -v key="${key}" '$1==key {sub(/^[^=]*=/,"",$0); print $0}' | tail -n 1)"
  [[ -n "${value}" ]] || fail "${key} is empty in runtime service spec (${SERVICE_NAME})"
  ok "${key} is set in runtime service spec"
done

verify_runtime_database "${SERVICE_NAME}" "DATABASE_URI"

./scripts/verify.sh
echo "Deploy complete."

```
